releases.summary: The replica automation status read and five-second refresh move from SettingsScreen.tsx into a useReplicaStatus hook with direct tests; support diagnostics hook indentation is corrected.
Support diagnostics preview, copy, activity log, and download move from SettingsScreen.tsx into a useSupportDiagnostics hook with direct tests.
The browser demo's plan handlers (preview and revise) move into lib/mockPlanHandlers.ts, apart from the print and diagnostics handlers.
The browser demo's preview and revise handlers move from mockBridge.ts into lib/mockHandlers.ts, sharing one plan state object.
The browser demo's stateless RFI print finder and diagnostics handlers move from mockBridge.ts into lib/mockHandlers.ts.
The preview run, which saves parameters and requests the engine preview, moves from OperationScreen.tsx into a usePreviewRun hook with direct tests.
The apply run, including the revise-then-apply path and the new-warning stop, moves from OperationScreen.tsx into a useApplyRun hook with direct tests.
The RFI reply preview and undo actions move from OperationScreen.tsx into a useResultActions hook with direct tests.
The table copy action and its in-flight sheet state move from OperationScreen.tsx into a useCopyTable hook with direct tests.
Preview and apply cancel handlers move from OperationScreen.tsx into a useRunCancel hook with direct tests.
The fast-scan preview re-run moves from OperationScreen.tsx into a useScanPreviewUpdate hook with direct tests.
The batch print queue's load, resume, and discard logic moves from OperationScreen.tsx into a usePrintQueue hook with direct tests.
The operation run's progress state moves from OperationScreen.tsx into a useProgressTrail hook with direct tests.
The browser demo's recovery list handler moves out of the MockBridge dispatch switch into its own method.
The browser demo's support diagnostics handler moves out of the MockBridge dispatch switch into its own method.
The browser demo's history list handler moves out of the MockBridge dispatch switch into its own method.
The browser demo's RFI print finder handler moves into its own method and gains a direct MockBridge test.
The browser demo's engine/revise handler moves out of the MockBridge dispatch switch into its own method.
The browser demo's engine/preview handler moves out of the MockBridge dispatch switch into its own method.
The check that sends a revised plan with new warnings back to review moves into a tested helper, hasNewWarnings.
Duplicate-preset detection and date formatting gain direct tests.
A catalog test guards that every locale has the English message keys and matching placeholders.
Plan editor date parsing and formatting gain direct tests for the day, leap-year, and year-window rules.
Signed-warning review items gain direct tests for status allow-listing, reason filtering, and page-number sanitizing.
The shared helpers gain direct tests for RFI input parsing, path selection, and human-readable error mapping.
The queue's failure message mapping gains direct tests for watch, generic, and missing codes.
The Outlook reply preview trust-boundary check gains direct tests.
The home screen's operation category lookup moves into lib/operationCategory.ts with a test.
The plan table's option lookup, direct or dependent on another field, moves into editorRules.ts with direct tests.
The plan table's change, review, and search filter moves into editorRules.ts with direct tests.
Plan row duplicate, remove, and move rules move into editorRules.ts; the last row of a group stays protected and has direct tests.
Plan cell auto-fill and regex-fill rules move into editorRules.ts with direct tests.
The browser demo bridge's fixtures and helpers move from mockBridge.ts into lib/mockFixtures.ts.
Frontend helpers and components used only in their own file are no longer exported.
Unused frontend preset wrappers and two unreferenced demo operation definitions are removed.
App.tsx drops its re-export barrel; tests import helpers from their own modules.
Signed-warning review helpers move from PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/signedWarnings.ts.
Plan impact summary helpers move from PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/planImpact.ts.
Workbook cell change summary helpers move from PlanSummaries.tsx into plan/workbookCellChanges.ts.
Progress-trail, editor-row, and remembered-parameter helpers move from OperationScreen.tsx into screens/operationState.ts.
Pure editor rules (column widths, value display, confidence formatting, RFI code checks, plan readiness) move from EditablePlanTable.tsx into plan/editorRules.ts.
The batch-print RFI finder state and search logic move into a useRfiPrintFinder hook.
Batch-print RFI number checkboxes render in their own component.
Batch-print RFI finder results render in their own component.
Below 360px the phone bottom bar is icon-only with 40px targets; wider phones keep the named current section.
Preview and apply progress share one screen component instead of two copies.
At phone width the bottom bar names the current section; the other sections stay icon-only.
Batch print preview values come from a tested helper instead of inline reshaping in the operation screen.
Operation screen uses one helper for the values it remembers instead of three copies of the same filter.
The browser mock enforces required parameters like the engine, and its UI tests wait for picked paths.
Engine previews reject a missing required parameter before any operation work, with messages in all four languages.
Known issues record that the Outlook archive preview has no operator route yet.
Stale dead_code allows and a superseded Outlook reply preview are removed; the remaining allows name their reason.
Journal lock re-enters for the same store on the same thread and waits briefly for short holds, fixing intermittent operation_in_progress failures.
The browser mock bridge moves out of the Tauri bridge into its own module.
Plan editor date helpers and the compact date input move into their own modules.
Scan OCR adapter types and scan-editor revision logic move into their own process_scans modules.
Sign-in and sign-up email fields show a mail icon and the password field a lock icon.
Scan-index, system-sync, and signed-page archive helpers take grouped arguments instead of long parameter lists.
Review, Queue, History, Recovery, and Admin screens load on first visit, trimming the startup bundle.
Two unused Follow Up helper functions are removed.
A test fails when TypeScript wire types drift from the Rust DTO fields they mirror.
Browser demo operation definitions move out of the bridge into their own module.
Recovery entries type the optional warning and locator fields the backend sends.
Rust CI tests no longer clean and recheck the crate after running the test suite.
npm run gate runs every repository verification gate in one command.
Quality CI also runs on pushes to main; a pre-commit hook enforces the version and source checks.
Follow Up sync can write its backup copy to a chosen folder.
Follow Up keeps all 21 Roads with their zones.
Excel-safe row insertion (no references past the last row) and labeled-identity cover confirmation.
Structural validation before publishing rewritten worksheets; Road part rows applied with the sync.
Per-cell Follow Up remarks and automatic repair of empty formula cells.
Follow Up manages Road part rows from the Log and pauses mass removals.
Follow Up writes and clears generated row remarks on CIV, PCU, and Road.

Local activity log with one-click redacted export for support.

Follow Up sync names the exact safe-processing limit that was exceeded.

Limit Rust cache growth and local artifacts; restore test compilation and satisfy current Rust quality gates.

Increase OOXML MAX_ENTRY_BYTES to 128MB to safely support large workbooks with 180k+ changelog rows, and verify end-to-end follow up synchronization.

Optional flat output mode for Process Scans.

Automated Windows cross-build with bundled OCR, HTML5 drag-and-drop on form path inputs, persistent parameter auto-save and reuse, flexible RFI header layout discovery, and 1-click diagnostic export.

UI/UX layout overhaul: eliminate button overlap, fix unclosed dark media query, decouple table action headers from column count, dock action bars without covering form fields, auto-close date dropdowns, and add 1-click path reset.
